neighbours.label: The name of a profession or craft as an activity (acting, conducting, filmmaking, teaching, design, programming, bartending), esp. after 'for/in/of/at' where a skill or career would follow; fires on the word's stem token, covers a mix of occupations and disciplines
fire: After twenty years of high school teaching, Marta finally retired to the coast and took up gardening.
He tried his hand at amateur filmmaking before anyone in the family took his talent seriously.
My cousin left a stable job because her real passion was always graphic design, even as a kid.
The orchestra praised the young maestro for his bold and expressive conducting last night.
Years of night shifts in bartending taught me more about people than any textbook ever did.
She enrolled in an evening course on web programming and finished the first module in a week.
You never forget your first big break in acting, the nerves, the lights, the silence before the line.
Growing up near the shipyards, he developed an early love for marine engineering and tinkered with boat motors.
quiet: After twenty years in that quiet school building, Marta finally retired to the coast and took up gardening.
He tried to film a short clip on his phone before anyone in the family noticed the broken window.
My cousin left a stable job because the commute through the tunnel was draining her, even as a kid she hated traffic.
The orchestra praised the weather for staying mild and dry during the open-air concert last night.
Years of night shifts at the harbor taught me more about loneliness than any textbook ever did.
She enrolled in an evening course on medieval history and finished the first reading in a week.
You never forget the first big storm on the lake, the wind, the cold, the silence before the thunder.
Growing up near the shipyards, he developed an early love for the smell of diesel and tinkered with boat motors.

notes: 10x pilot (concept-maps/tenx, census arm): label and 16 sentences written by a fresh Sonnet 5.5 subagent from a packet (card + all-pole band samples + concept-census evidence (which concepts and domains selected the pole)); no probes. An Opus gate checked rule-level items only (8 + 8, 0 overlap with census and probe text, near misses free of the declared trigger) and edited nothing. Labeller's note: Top examples are all stems of occupation/craft gerunds (conducting, bartending, filmmaking, choreographing, teaching, acting, design); census shows 65% of profession items fire it versus ~0% of objects, and the output suppresses ' profession/skills/expertise'. Strong activations also include discipline names (engineering, photography, singing), so coverage is a mix of professions and disciplines.
